daily_journal.title: Daily Journal
prompts: What is one small thing you were grateful for today?
Name one negative thought, and let's find evidence that it might not be true.
If your best friend felt the way you do right now, what would you tell them?
What is one thing out of your control today, and how can you let it go?
Write down three strengths that have helped you survive so far.
What is one thing you can do tomorrow to make yourself feel a little better?

diagnose.title: Mind Check-In
diagnose.subtitle: A supportive, expert-guided assessment to help you understand your current feelings and detect early signs of mental health distress.

no_results.title: No assessments yet
no_results.desc: Start your first Mind Check-In to gain valuable insights about your mental well-being. It only takes a few minutes.

severity_desc.normal: You're in a healthy mental state. Keep maintaining your well-being and self-care routines.
severity_desc.mild: You're feeling emotionally drained. Make sure to get plenty of rest. This is a safe space for you to take a short break.
severity_desc.moderate: You're experiencing moderate emotional distress. Consider reaching out to someone you trust.
severity_desc.severe: You're going through significant emotional challenges. We strongly recommend consulting a professional.
severity_desc.extremely_severe: You're experiencing very high levels of distress. Please seek professional help immediately.

helpPage.outOfRangeDesc: There are currently no practitioners available within a {{radius}} km radius from your location. Here is a list of recommended practitioners from other cities.
helpPage.comingSoonDesc: Consultation scheduling will open shortly! Please stay tuned for updates on our app.

mindCheckFlow.title: Mind Check-In
mindCheckFlow.description: You will answer 21 short questions to measure your current mental health level. Answer honestly based on your experience over the past 1 week.
mindCheckFlow.disclaimer: These results are informational and not a medical diagnosis. If your symptoms persist, please consult a mental health professional.

never.label: Never
never.desc: Did not apply to me at all

sometimes.label: Sometimes
sometimes.desc: Applied to me to some degree, or some of the time

often.label: Often
often.desc: Applied to me to a considerable degree or a good part of time

almostAlways.label: Almost Always
almostAlways.desc: Applied to me very much or most of the time

questions.q1: I found it hard to wind down.
questions.q2: I was aware of dryness of my mouth.
questions.q3: I couldn't seem to experience any positive feeling at all.
questions.q4: I experienced breathing difficulty (e.g. excessively rapid breathing, breathlessness in the absence of physical exertion).
questions.q5: I found it difficult to work up the initiative to do things.
questions.q6: I tended to over-react to situations.
questions.q7: I experienced trembling (e.g. in the hands).
questions.q8: I felt that I was using a lot of nervous energy.
questions.q9: I was worried about situations in which I might panic and make a fool of myself.
questions.q10: I felt that I had nothing to look forward to.
questions.q12: I found it difficult to relax.
questions.q14: I was intolerant of anything that kept me from getting on with what I was doing.
questions.q15: I felt I was close to panic.
questions.q16: I was unable to become enthusiastic about anything.
questions.q17: I felt I wasn't worth much as a person.
questions.q18: I felt that I was rather touchy.
questions.q19: I was aware of the action of my heart in the absence of physical exertion.
questions.q20: I felt scared without any good reason.
questions.q21: I felt that life was meaningless.

step1.title: Hello, {{name}}
step1.desc: Welcome to Komorebi! I'm Komi, your virtual companion. I'll guide you through the platform. Let's take a quick tour!

step2.title: Mood Tracker
step2.desc: You can log your daily mood here. I will even change my color based on how you feel!

step3.title: Mood History
step3.desc: See a summary of your mood over the past week or month. The more you log, the more accurate the data!

step4.title: Assessment History
step4.desc: View your mental health assessment history here. All results are securely stored and accessible anytime.

step5.title: Activity Recommendations
step5.desc: I've also prepared a list of activities tailored to your current mood. Take a moment to relax!

step6.title: Reflection Journal
step6.desc: The Reflection page is where you write your daily journal. The more you write, the longer your streak, and the happier I get!

step7.title: Mental Health Diagnose
step7.desc: Need a check-up? You can take a free mental health test guided by our expert system here.

step8.title: Chat with Komi
step8.desc: You can double-click me anytime, or visit this menu to chat directly with me! I'm always ready to listen.

step9.title: Sharing Room
step9.desc: In the Sharing Forum, you can share stories, read others' experiences, and support each other in a safe community.

step10.title: Professional Help
step10.desc: Need professional help? In this Help menu, you can find trusted Psychiatrists and Psychologists for further consultation.

step11.title: Enjoy Exploring, {{name}}!
step11.desc: That's everything! You can start exploring now. I'll always be in the corner if you need a friend. Don't forget to log your journal!

mobile.title: Main Menu (Sidebar)
mobile.desc: To access the Reflection Journal, Psychology Diagnose, AI Chat, and Sharing Forum, please tap the Hamburger icon (☰) in the top right corner!
